c.description: array of shape ``(..., N)`` specifying the first column.
constraints: Leading dimensions of c and r must be broadcast-compatible
For N-dimensional c and/or r, the result is a batch of Hankel matrices

r.description: (optional) array of shape ``(..., M)`` specifying the last row. Leading dimensions must be broadcast-compatible with those of ``c``. If not specified, ``r`` defaults to ``zeros_like(c)``.
constraints: Leading dimensions of c and r must be broadcast-compatible
r[0] is ignored in the result
For N-dimensional c and/or r, the result is a batch of Hankel matrices

output.description: A Hankel matrix of shape ``(..., N, M)``.

constraints: Leading dimensions of c and r must be broadcast-compatible
For N-dimensional c and/or r, the result is a batch of Hankel matrices
